n01b7739ec5.headline: Zimbabwe dollar officially breaches $20 000 to the US dollar | The Insider
n01b7739ec5.summary: The Zimbabwean dollar dropped below $20,000 against the US dollar, trading at $20,389 per greenback. It has lost 70% of its value since the start of the year, according to the report.
n01b7739ec5.why: A currency losing value against the US dollar raises import costs and inflation pressure, and it affects the valuation of local-currency assets for investors in Zimbabwe.

source.name: The Insider | News about Zimbabwe that you can use

n01b7739ec5.why_moved: The report cites cumulative losses of 70% since the start of the year, with the currency falling past the 10,000 level in late January.

n6cd2b9307a.headline: Egypt signs MoU to establish a Turkish logistics industrial zone in Jarjoub
n6cd2b9307a.summary: Egypt's maritime logistics arm, Inventure Alliance and Turkish company DOGUS signed a memorandum of understanding to establish a Turkish logistics industrial zone in Jarjoub.
n6cd2b9307a.why: Logistics industrial zones attract foreign investment and trade, and they connect port and manufacturing activity in Egypt with Turkish partners.
